The main feature of the park is spring-fed gully filled with piccabeen palms. Strangler figs, bunya pines and hoop pines also predominate.


== History ==
The 12.4 ha park was proclaimed in 1950.


== Attractions ==
The birdlife in the park is prolific.
No camping is allowed in the park but picnics and bushwalks are catered for.


== See also ==

Protected areas of Queensland
